§5.14 Multidimensional Integrals

ⓘ
Keywords:
beta function, gamma function, integral representations, multidimensional
Notes:
See Andrews et al. (1999, pp. 32–34, 401–410, and 426). For (5.14.7) see Mehta (2004, pp. 224–227).
Permalink:

Let Vn be the simplex: t1+t2+⋯+tn≤1, tk≥0. Then for ℜ⁡zk>0, k=1,2,…,n+1,

5.14.1 ∫Vnt1z1−1⁢t2z2−1⁢⋯⁢tnzn−1⁢dt1⁢dt2⁢⋯⁢dtn=Γ⁡(z1)⁢Γ⁡(z2)⁢⋯⁢Γ⁡(zn)Γ⁡(1+z1+z2+⋯+zn),
ⓘ

5.14.3 Δ⁡(t1,t2,…,tn)=∏1≤j<k≤n(tj−tk).

Symbols:
